# Rapar Rubel (Rubel Miah)

> Rapar Rubel is the online name of Rubel Miah, also known as Rubel Public: a business builder, content strategist and AI & product operator based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. His core strength is reading the audience (the words people use, what they fear and what they share) and turning that into content, brands, products and operating systems in Bangla, Banglish and English.

## Identity
- Real name: Rubel Miah
- Online / creative name: Rapar Rubel
- Other public identity: Rubel Public
- Based in: Dhaka, Bangladesh (GMT+6)
- Role: Business Builder, Content Strategist, AI & Product Operator, Independent Business Architect
- Personal AI agent: Paloan (in development; a guide version answers questions on the portfolio site)

## Content approach
1. Listen: collect the exact words the audience uses (comments, inbox, reviews, searches)
2. Decode: find the need, fear and hope under the request
3. Frame: one angle, one emotion; the brand as the answer to a need
4. Create: native content in Bangla, Banglish or English for each platform
5. Test & systemise: keep what drives saves, shares, replies and sales; make it repeatable

## Services
- Content strategy, audience research and brand psychology; Banglish/Bangla copy, product photography and social creative
- Business strategy: business models, pricing, offers, funnels, operating plans
- AI: agents, prompt systems, workflow automation, team training in Bangla and English
- Product: websites, web apps and internal tools from brief to launch
- Creative: brand systems, campaigns, social creative, AI video direction
- Operations: hands-on coordination across technology, retail, property and marketing
